_readme: Fixes applied to the SWU-DB data on every update (python -m swu_momir.data.cards). Rule for Ambush and Sentinel: a player paying for the filter should get a unit that has the keyword itself as it's played. So a unit is tagged only if it always has the keyword or is sure to have it when played. Units that only have it under another condition, or that only give, remove, or refer to it, are not tagged. These keep their tags for that reason and so aren't listed here: Captain Rex (SEC-048) and Calculating MagnaGuard (TWI-033) give themselves Sentinel when played; Millennium Falcon (SHD-204) gains Ambush when played from hand; and Rotunda Senate Guards (SEC-063), Vigilant Honor Guards (SOR-048), 501st Veteran (TS26-20), and General Grievous (TS26-50) have Sentinel while undamaged. Under the game rules that your base counts as every type and that you start with the Force, Soaring Can-Cell (HMW-131), Wookiee Rangers (HMW-142), Jedi Sentinel (LOF-196), and Darth Tyranus (LOF-231) keep their tags too. 'card' can be any printing of the unit. The update reports entries that no longer change anything, so they can be deleted.
